rules: .scroll-fade-x { --_scroll-fade-size-s: var(--scroll-fade-s-size,var(--scroll-fade-size,min(12%, calc(var(--spacing) * 10)))); --_scroll-fade-size-e: var(--scroll-fade-e-size,var(--scroll-fade-size,min(12%, calc(var(--spacing) * 10)))); --scroll-fade-inline: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-s,0px), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-e,0px)), transparent 100%); }

.scroll-fade-x:where([dir="rtl"], [dir="rtl"] *) { --scroll-fade-inline: linear-gradient(to left, transparent 0, #000 var(--scroll-fade-s,0px), #000 calc(100% - var(--scroll-fade-e,0px)), transparent 100%); }
